facts.fact: The Economic Commission for Africa's annex table on the status of civil registration and vital statistics systems lists Ghana with its comprehensive assessment completed and its improvement plan developed; no date is given, so the document's printing date is used.
facts.system: civil registration and vital statistics system

systems.system: civil registration and vital statistics system

note: The only Ghana line is one row of the annex status table (columns: country, assessment status, plan; headings taken from the full document, as the passage file omits them); the plan is a CRVS improvement plan and the table says nothing on whether registration is digital.
